digest.en: Middle East & Africa leads the board this hour with Ebola en RDC, une épidémie hors de contrôle ?. 25 fresh dispatches in this edition.
digest.hi: इस घंटे बोर्ड पर एशिया-प्रशांत की अगुवाई है, ‘ये हमारी दोस्ती का प्रतीक है’, बालेन शाह ने जताया पीएम मोदी का आभार, संकट की घड़ी में नेपाल पहुंची मुख्य खबर है। कुल 25 ताज़ा खबरें इस संस्करण में हैं।

articles.title: Ebola en RDC, une épidémie hors de contrôle ?
articles.summary: Dans cet épisode d’Afrique 360°, Enrica Picco et Rinaldo Depagne reçoivent Frédéric Manantsoa Lai, coordinateur des urgences pour Médecins Sans Frontières, et Onesphore Sematumba, analyste senior pour la République démocratique du Congo et le Burundi à Crisis Group, pour parler de l’épidémie d’Ebola en RDC et de ses conséquences sur la population congolaise, déjà marquée par des années de conflit.

articles.title: Avrupa Birliği ve Türkiye: Savunmada Birlik?
articles.summary: İkinci Dünya Savaşı sonrasında şekillenen uluslararası düzen giderek çözülürken, Ankara ve diğer Avrupa başkentlerindeki yetkililer güvenlik alanında birlikte hareket etmedikleri takdirde ciddi risklerle karşı karşıya kalacaklarının giderek daha fazla farkına varıyor. Tehdit algıları farklılık gösterse de, pragmatik ve esnek iş birliği yolları geliştirmeleri hâlâ mümkün. Avrupa Birliği ve Türkiye: Savunmada Birlik?

articles.title: At least 95 dead, over 350 missing; India sends first tranche of relief materials
articles.summary: India announced it will send relief supplies For assistance and information related to Indian nationals that have been affected by the flash floods in Nepal today, the following emergency numbers may be contacted: +977 985 131 6807, +977 970 910 7500, said a post by the Indian embassy in Nepal. Several feared dead, India to send relief materials. At least 18 feared dead, over 350 missing, India to send relief materials.

articles.title: 20 Tamil Nadu pilgrims marked safe, at least 37 still missing as landslips disrupt route
articles.summary: As per initial information, the pilgrims were on board three vehicles and occupants of one of the vehicles have taken refuge in a Armed Police Force outpost at Timure, about 150 km north of Kathmandu At least 50 pilgrims from Tamil Nadu stranded as landslips disrupt route. 20 Tamil Nadu pilgrims from Tamil Nadu rescued, at least 37 still as landslips disrupt route.

articles.title: What triggered the deadly Himalayan disaster?
articles.summary: A devastating flash flood has struck Nepal’s Rasuwa district near the Tibet border, leaving at least eight people dead and hundreds reported missing. The disaster swept through the Bhote Koshi River basin, causing widespread destruction to villages, roads, bridges and major hydropower projects. Authorities say hundreds of travellers are unaccounted for, including foreign tourists from several coun What triggered the deadly Himalayan disaster?

articles.title: Kremlin says US spy chief met with Russian counterparts during Moscow visit
articles.summary: US President Donald Trump did not make it clear what the officials were there to discuss, but said the visit could be useful, adding, “something may come out of it” as efforts to end the Ukraine war continue. Kremlin says US spy chief met with Russian counterparts during Moscow visit.

articles.title: Western disturbance linked to Nepal floods
articles.summary: A senior IMD official said the western disturbance may contribute to the broader rainfall The western disturbance is a possible contributor to the broader rainfall environment rather than an established direct cause of the flash flood; the immediate mechanism behind the sudden release of water remains under investigation, a senior IMD official says. Western disturbance linked to Nepal floods.

articles.title: Life-Saving Resource Or Political Weapon?
articles.summary: The Ibar River feeds Lake Gazivode, providing drinking water as well as water for crop irrigation and cooling power plants across Kosovo. But after recent local disputes, Serbian President Aleksandar Vucic has raised the prospect of altering the river's course upstream. Life-Saving Resource Or Political Weapon?

articles.title: Remembering Dolly Parton, who gave away everything but her songs
articles.summary: The Queen of Country Music, who passed away recently, gave away more than 300 million books and millions of dollars in aid, but refused to surrender the copyright to one song, even for Elvis Presley. Remembering Dolly Parton, who gave away everything but her songs.

articles.summary: South Korea is betting extraordinary sums on artificial intelligence. President Lee Jae-myung has backed an 800 trillion won (US$578 billion) semiconductor expansion involving Samsung Electronics and SK Hynix, promoted a new chip hub in the country’s southwest and joined Korean and US technology companies in AI initiatives valued at hundreds of billions of dollars. articles.title: India-France eye a mutually convenient next-gen fighter deal
articles.summary: India’s interest in joining the French-led Future Combat Air System (FCAS) program reflects a convergence of strategic necessity, where India needs a credible path to next-generation airpower, while France needs a financially and industrially viable partner to sustain its sixth-generation fighter ambitions. This month, India formally began exploring participation in FCAS, according to disclosures India-France eye a mutually convenient next-gen fighter deal.

articles.summary: Wars in the 21st century aren’t fought only with missiles and soldiers anymore. Increasingly, they’re fought through banking systems, shipping lanes, semiconductor controls and currency clearing networks. The battlefield has quietly expanded from territory to economic architecture. And what’s happened so far in 2026 suggests that architecture is now splitting into two. articles.title: CIA Director Ratcliffe's Surprise Moscow Trip Raises Questions Over Russia, Ukraine, Iran
articles.summary: CIA Director John Ratcliffe made an unannounced visit to Moscow on August 25, US officials confirmed to RFE/RL, a rare trip that comes as Washington’s efforts to end Russia’s war against Ukraine have stalled and tensions over Moscow’s relationship with Iran have intensified. CIA Director Ratcliffe's Surprise Moscow Trip Raises Questions Over Russia, Ukraine, Iran.

articles.summary: Volunteers in the Penza region town of Bashmakovo have formed patrols to prevent military recruiters from taking local men to fight in Ukraine, an unusual grassroots response to the Russian state’s increasingly aggressive efforts to find troops for the war Aggressive Recruiters Are Rounding Up Russians To Fight In Ukraine. In One Town, They're Pushing.

articles.title: Russian Children Reportedly Beaten, Injured At Patriotic Camp Funded By Kremlin
articles.summary: Children at a Russian Orthodox Christian military-patriotic camp have allegedly been beaten and subjected to other physical punishment, prompting a criminal investigation and scrutiny of an organization that has received millions of rubles in state grants. Russian Children Reportedly Beaten, Injured At Patriotic Camp Funded By Kremlin.

articles.summary: US president has been obsessed with restricting the ability to vote by mail, despite using it himself. The US supreme court has sided with Donald Trump in his effort to crack down on mail-in voting, though it is unclear whether or not his administration will be ab.

articles.title: Haiti ramps up the fight against gangs in the capital, but violence spreads elsewhere
articles.summary: The killings in Kenscoff began late Sunday, when armed men descended on the farming community in the hills overlooking Haiti’s capital, setting homes ablaze and attacking residents. By Monday, bodies lay in the streets and survivors were searching for missing relatives. Haiti ramps up the fight against gangs in the capital, but violence spreads elsewhere.

articles.title: As wars spread, the global food system unravels
articles.summary: A family with four children abandoned its farm in Somalia after armed groups arrived and demanded payments for the right to continue cultivating the land. They walked roughly 100 kilometers to a displacement camp. One of the children died along the way. As wars spread, the global food system unravels.

articles.title: Land degradation is costing far more than restoring: UN deputy chief
articles.summary: Countries are spending too little to restore degraded land even as the economic cost of doing nothing climbs towards $1 trillion a year, UN Deputy Secretary-General Amina Mohammed warned at a major UN land conference in Mongolia. Land degradation is costing far more than restoring: UN deputy chief.

articles.title: Colombia’s new president Abelardo de la Espriella announces immigration crackdown
articles.summary: Far-right leader echoes ally Donald Trump and says operations to ‘track down illegal immigrants’ should begin this week, amid earthquake aftermathColombia’s far-right president, Abelardo de la Espriella, has announced a crackdown on immigrants, ordering authorities to detain and deport people who are in the country irregularly or have committed crimes. articles.title: Ukraine Appeals For More Air Defense Amid Independence Celebrations
articles.summary: As Ukraine marked the 35th anniversary of its declaration of independence from the Soviet Union, Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy hosted a summit of world leaders from the so-called Coalition of the Willing -- a group of countries that has pledged military and security support for Ukraine. Ukraine Appeals For More Air Defense Amid Independence Celebrations.

articles.summary: नेपाल के रसुवागढ़ी में हिमस्खलन और अचानक आई बाढ़ से हालात बहुत खराब हो गए हैं. ऐसे मुश्किल समय में भारत ने एक बार फिर अपने पड़ोसी देश की मदद के लिए हाथ बढ़ाया है. बाढ़ में सड़कें और पुल बहने से कई इलाकों का संपर्क पूरी तरह टूट गया है. यहां कैलाश मानसरोवर यात्रा पर निकले 100 से ज्यादा भारतीयों समेत सैकड़ों लोग फंसे हुए हैं. भारत सरकार ने बिना देर किए मदद भेजने की तैयारी कर ली है.

articles.summary: भारत के पड़ोस में यह एक इस्लामिक धड़ा तैयार हो गया है. पाकिस्तान, सऊदी अरब और तुर्की के गठजोड़ वाले मक्का रक्षा समझौते में बांग्लादेश भी एंट्री पाने के लिए तैयारी कर रहा है. सवाल बांग्लादेश को लेकर है, जिसने इस ग्रुप में शामिल होने को लेकर दिलचस्पी दिखाई है. हालांकि बांग्लादेश की हुकूमत ने जिस कबाब का ख्वाब सजाया हुआ है, उसमें एक छोटी सी हड्डी भी है जो रंग में भंग डाल सकती है.

articles.summary: नेपाल में अचानक आई भीषण बाढ़ ने भारी तबाही मचाई है. यह बाढ़ चीन के तिब्बत बॉर्डर की तरफ से आई है. नेपाली जर्नलिस्ट परशुराम काफ्ले ने चीन पर गंभीर आरोप लगाए हैं. उन्होंने कहा कि चीन ने बाढ़ का कोई अर्ली वार्निंग अलर्ट नहीं दिया. इस वजह से 105 भारतीयों समेत 384 लोग लापता हैं. नेपाल में 7 लोगों की मौत हो चुकी है. आर्मी लगातार रेस्क्यू ऑपरेशन चला रही है.

articles.title: महिला वोट बैंक पर सरकारें मेहरबान क्यों? BJP का 'वादा निभाने' का गणित
articles.summary: इन दिनों देशभर में महिलाओं के लिए सरकारी योजनाओं की बाढ़ आ गई है. उत्तर प्रदेश में बुजुर्ग महिलाओं के लिए फ्री बस की सुविधा शुरू हो गई है, बिहार सरकार ने रक्षाबंधन के मौके पर बेटियों के लिए बड़े ऐलान किए हैं और दिल्ली में महिलाओं को लक्ष्मी योजना के तहत पैसे मिलना शुरू हो रहे हैं. एक तरफ बीजेपी वादा निभाने का है संदेश दे रही है, तो दूसरी तरफ महिलाएं वफादार वोटर्स साबित हो रही हैं.
